How fast can you start?

Usually within two weeks of the first call.

Do you work with companies outside the UK?

Yes – about a third of our clients are in Europe and the US. Workshops run on site or remote.

What size of company do you work with?

Mostly 20–500 people. Smaller teams usually start with the Diagnostic package.

Can we pay in stages?

Yes. Sprints are paid 50% at the start and 50% at the end.
